narrative: On the tables. The writing-tables. Three words, one under another, and a blank under those. The pen down. No sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the three words, and stopped.

entities.name: Richard Quiney
entities.context: Named, and not yet written to.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Three words, and nothing under them
